name: Liquid type
look: A very large headline ripples and stretches like type seen through water: one ripple passes through it from left to right each time it comes on screen, the pointer ripples it wherever it crosses the letters, and a tap or a touch drag ripples it at the finger; it settles back to crisp type within about a second. One SVG filter, only while it moves.
phone: It runs on a phone: the ripple passes through the headline as it comes on screen, and a tap or a touch drag ripples it again.

needs.words: a headline of 2 to 6 words, set large
